# Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Control Plane API reference

> Welcome to the Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Control plane API reference. Control plane actions configure, create, modify, and monitor AWS resources.

- [Welcome](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/Welcome.md)
- [Common Parameters](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/CommonParameters.md)
- [Common Error Types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/CommonErrors.md)

## [Actions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_Operations.md)

- [AddDatasetExamples](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_AddDatasetExamples.md): Adds examples to the dataset's DRAFT.
- [CreateAgentRuntime](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_CreateAgentRuntime.md): Creates an Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Runtime.
- [CreateAgentRuntimeEndpoint](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_CreateAgentRuntimeEndpoint.md): Creates an AgentCore Runtime endpoint.
- [CreateApiKeyCredentialProvider](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_CreateApiKeyCredentialProvider.md): Creates a new API key credential provider.
- [CreateBrowser](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_CreateBrowser.md): Creates a custom browser.
- [CreateBrowserProfile](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_CreateBrowserProfile.md): Creates a browser profile in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore.
- [CreateCodeInterpreter](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_CreateCodeInterpreter.md): Creates a custom code interpreter.
- [CreateConfigurationBundle](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_CreateConfigurationBundle.md): Creates a new configuration bundle resource.
- [CreateDataset](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_CreateDataset.md): Creates a new dataset resource asynchronously.
- [CreateDatasetVersion](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_CreateDatasetVersion.md): Publishes the current DRAFT as a new numbered version.
- [CreateEvaluator](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_CreateEvaluator.md): Creates a custom evaluator for agent quality assessment.
- [CreateGateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_CreateGateway.md): Creates a gateway for Amazon Bedrock Agent.
- [CreateGatewayRule](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_CreateGatewayRule.md): Creates a rule for a gateway.
- [CreateGatewayTarget](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_CreateGatewayTarget.md): Creates a target for a gateway.
- [CreateHarness](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_CreateHarness.md): Operation to create a harness.
- [CreateHarnessEndpoint](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_CreateHarnessEndpoint.md): Operation to create a harness endpoint.
- [CreateMemory](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_CreateMemory.md): Creates a new Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Memory resource.
- [CreateOauth2CredentialProvider](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_CreateOauth2CredentialProvider.md): Creates a new OAuth2 credential provider.
- [CreateOnlineEvaluationConfig](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_CreateOnlineEvaluationConfig.md): Creates an online evaluation configuration for continuous monitoring of agent performance.
- [CreatePaymentConnector](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_CreatePaymentConnector.md): Creates a new payment connector for a payment manager.
- [CreatePaymentCredentialProvider](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_CreatePaymentCredentialProvider.md): Creates a new payment credential provider for storing authentication credentials used by payment connectors to communicate with external payment providers.
- [CreatePaymentManager](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_CreatePaymentManager.md): Creates a new payment manager in your AWS account.
- [CreatePolicy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_CreatePolicy.md): Creates a policy within the AgentCore Policy system.
- [CreatePolicyEngine](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_CreatePolicyEngine.md): Creates a new policy engine within the AgentCore Policy system.
- [CreateRegistry](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_CreateRegistry.md): Creates a new registry in your AWS account.
- [CreateRegistryRecord](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_CreateRegistryRecord.md): Creates a new registry record within the specified registry.
- [CreateWorkloadIdentity](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_CreateWorkloadIdentity.md): Creates a new workload identity.
- [DeleteAgentRuntime](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_DeleteAgentRuntime.md): Deletes an Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Runtime.
- [DeleteAgentRuntimeEndpoint](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_DeleteAgentRuntimeEndpoint.md): Deletes an AAgentCore Runtime endpoint.
- [DeleteApiKeyCredentialProvider](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_DeleteApiKeyCredentialProvider.md): Deletes an API key credential provider.
- [DeleteBrowser](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_DeleteBrowser.md): Deletes a custom browser.
- [DeleteBrowserProfile](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_DeleteBrowserProfile.md): Deletes a browser profile.
- [DeleteCodeInterpreter](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_DeleteCodeInterpreter.md): Deletes a custom code interpreter.
- [DeleteConfigurationBundle](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_DeleteConfigurationBundle.md): Deletes a configuration bundle and all of its versions.
- [DeleteDataset](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_DeleteDataset.md): Deletes a dataset version or an entire dataset asynchronously.
- [DeleteDatasetExamples](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_DeleteDatasetExamples.md): Deletes specific examples by ID from DRAFT.
- [DeleteEvaluator](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_DeleteEvaluator.md): Deletes a custom evaluator.
- [DeleteGateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_DeleteGateway.md): Deletes a gateway.
- [DeleteGatewayRule](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_DeleteGatewayRule.md): Deletes a gateway rule.
- [DeleteGatewayTarget](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_DeleteGatewayTarget.md): Deletes a gateway target.
- [DeleteHarness](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_DeleteHarness.md): Operation to delete a Harness.
- [DeleteHarnessEndpoint](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_DeleteHarnessEndpoint.md): Operation to delete a harness endpoint.
- [DeleteMemory](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_DeleteMemory.md): Deletes an Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Memory resource.
- [DeleteOauth2CredentialProvider](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_DeleteOauth2CredentialProvider.md): Deletes an OAuth2 credential provider.
- [DeleteOnlineEvaluationConfig](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_DeleteOnlineEvaluationConfig.md): Deletes an online evaluation configuration and stops any ongoing evaluation processes associated with it.
- [DeletePaymentConnector](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_DeletePaymentConnector.md): Deletes a payment connector.
- [DeletePaymentCredentialProvider](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_DeletePaymentCredentialProvider.md): Deletes a payment credential provider and its associated stored credentials.
- [DeletePaymentManager](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_DeletePaymentManager.md): Deletes a payment manager.
- [DeletePolicy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_DeletePolicy.md): Deletes an existing policy from the AgentCore Policy system.
- [DeletePolicyEngine](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_DeletePolicyEngine.md): Deletes an existing policy engine from the AgentCore Policy system.
- [DeleteRegistry](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_DeleteRegistry.md): Deletes a registry.
- [DeleteRegistryRecord](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_DeleteRegistryRecord.md): Deletes a registry record.
- [DeleteResourcePolicy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_DeleteResourcePolicy.md): Deletes the resource-based policy for a specified resource.
- [DeleteWorkloadIdentity](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_DeleteWorkloadIdentity.md): Deletes a workload identity.
- [GetAgentRuntime](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_GetAgentRuntime.md): Gets an Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Runtime.
- [GetAgentRuntimeEndpoint](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_GetAgentRuntimeEndpoint.md): Gets information about an Amazon Secure AgentEndpoint.
- [GetApiKeyCredentialProvider](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_GetApiKeyCredentialProvider.md): Retrieves information about an API key credential provider.

- [GetCodeInterpreter](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_GetCodeInterpreter.md): Gets information about a custom code interpreter.
- [GetConfigurationBundle](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_GetConfigurationBundle.md): Gets the latest version of a configuration bundle.
- [GetConfigurationBundleVersion](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_GetConfigurationBundleVersion.md): Gets a specific version of a configuration bundle by its version identifier.
- [GetDataset](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_GetDataset.md): Retrieves dataset metadata.
- [GetEvaluator](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_GetEvaluator.md): Retrieves detailed information about an evaluator, including its configuration, status, and metadata.

- [GetOnlineEvaluationConfig](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_GetOnlineEvaluationConfig.md): Retrieves detailed information about an online evaluation configuration, including its rules, data sources, evaluators, and execution status.
- [GetPaymentConnector](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_GetPaymentConnector.md): Retrieves information about a specific payment connector.
- [GetPaymentCredentialProvider](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_GetPaymentCredentialProvider.md): Retrieves information about a specific payment credential provider.
- [GetPaymentManager](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_GetPaymentManager.md): Retrieves information about a specific payment manager.
- [GetPolicy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_GetPolicy.md): Retrieves detailed information about a specific policy within the AgentCore Policy system.
- [GetPolicyEngine](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_GetPolicyEngine.md): Retrieves detailed information about a specific policy engine within the AgentCore Policy system.
- [GetPolicyEngineSummary](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_GetPolicyEngineSummary.md): Retrieves a metadata-only summary of a specific policy engine without decrypting customer content.
- [GetPolicyGeneration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_GetPolicyGeneration.md): Retrieves information about a policy generation request within the AgentCore Policy system.
- [GetPolicyGenerationSummary](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_GetPolicyGenerationSummary.md): Retrieves a metadata-only summary of a specific policy generation request without decrypting customer content.

- [GetRegistry](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_GetRegistry.md): Retrieves information about a specific registry.

- [ListDatasetVersions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_ListDatasetVersions.md): Lists all published versions of a dataset, sorted by version number descending (newest first).

- [ListMemories](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_ListMemories.md): Lists the available Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Memory resources in the current AWS Region.

- [ListPolicies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_ListPolicies.md): Retrieves a list of policies within the AgentCore Policy engine.
- [ListPolicyEngines](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_ListPolicyEngines.md): Retrieves a list of policy engines within the AgentCore Policy system.

- [ListPolicySummaries](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_ListPolicySummaries.md): Retrieves a paginated list of metadata-only policy summaries within a policy engine without decrypting customer content.
- [ListRegistries](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_ListRegistries.md): Lists all registries in the account.

- [ListWorkloadIdentities](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_ListWorkloadIdentities.md): Lists all workload identities in your account.
- [PutResourcePolicy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_PutResourcePolicy.md): Creates or updates a resource-based policy for a resource with the specified resourceArn.
- [SetTokenVaultCMK](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_SetTokenVaultCMK.md): Sets the customer master key (CMK) for a token vault.
- [StartPolicyGeneration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_StartPolicyGeneration.md): Initiates the AI-powered generation of Cedar policies from natural language descriptions within the AgentCore Policy system.
- [SubmitRegistryRecordForApproval](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_SubmitRegistryRecordForApproval.md): Submits a registry record for approval.
- [SynchronizeGatewayTargets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_SynchronizeGatewayTargets.md): Synchronizes the gateway targets by fetching the latest tool definitions from the target endpoints.
- [TagResource](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_TagResource.md): Associates the specified tags to a resource with the specified resourceArn.
- [UntagResource](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_UntagResource.md): Removes the specified tags from the specified resource.
- [UpdateAgentRuntime](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_UpdateAgentRuntime.md): Updates an existing Amazon Secure Agent.

- [UpdateOauth2CredentialProvider](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_UpdateOauth2CredentialProvider.md): Updates an existing OAuth2 credential provider.
- [UpdateOnlineEvaluationConfig](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_UpdateOnlineEvaluationConfig.md): Updates an online evaluation configuration's settings, including rules, data sources, evaluators, and execution status.
- [UpdatePaymentConnector](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_UpdatePaymentConnector.md): Updates an existing payment connector.

- [UpdatePaymentManager](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_UpdatePaymentManager.md): Updates an existing payment manager.
- [UpdatePolicy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_UpdatePolicy.md): Updates an existing policy within the AgentCore Policy system.
- [UpdatePolicyEngine](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_UpdatePolicyEngine.md): Updates an existing policy engine within the AgentCore Policy system.

- [UpdateWorkloadIdentity](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_UpdateWorkloadIdentity.md): Updates an existing workload identity.


## [Data Types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_Types.md)

- [A2aDescriptor](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_A2aDescriptor.md): The Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol descriptor for a registry record.
